selection: Five highest-probability false positives and five lowest-probability false negatives at fixed threshold 0.5, using the independently refitted validation model.
review_status: AI-assisted close reading of supplied labeled validation passages; Shenye's independent review is still required before submission. Hypotheses are not causal feature attributions.

cases.observation: An explanatory passage repeats corporate behaviour and lists general business benefits.
cases.hypothesis: Generic explanatory wording and repeated topic phrases may resemble AI training examples.

cases.observation: A recipe combines quantities and instructions with first-person comments and emphatic capitalization.
cases.hypothesis: Recipe templates and formatting may outweigh informal personal comments; first-person writing is not a reliable authorship rule.

cases.observation: A cake recipe contains two ingredient lists, repeated preparation instructions, temperatures and timing tips.
cases.hypothesis: Formulaic recipe structure may overlap with generated recipes despite informal spelling and a video link.

cases.observation: A short board-game question asks several related rhetorical questions and repeats game terminology.
cases.hypothesis: Question-heavy wording and limited context may be ambiguous under lexical and style features.

cases.observation: A general support/advice passage repeatedly contrasts attention with support.
cases.hypothesis: Broad advice and repeated abstract vocabulary may resemble AI advice passages.

cases.observation: A bank-history passage contains many institution names, dates, acronyms and a citation marker.
cases.hypothesis: Encyclopedia-like surface cues may resemble human reference prose; the model does not verify historical claims.

cases.observation: A first-person account of losing a dog uses short emotional sentences and repeated expressions of grief.
cases.hypothesis: Personal narrative cues may resemble human posts; emotional repetition does not uniquely identify AI.

cases.observation: A long first-person gaming proposal uses colloquial phrasing and repeated mission/mech terminology.
cases.hypothesis: Informal specialized discussion may resemble human forum prose even when labeled AI.

cases.observation: A swimmer biography lists dates, named institutions, competitions and results in reference-style paragraphs.
cases.hypothesis: Biographical structure and proper nouns may resemble human encyclopedia passages; factual accuracy was not externally checked.

cases.observation: An author biography includes an article-disambiguation opening, citation markers and a citation-needed marker.
cases.hypothesis: Reference formatting may act as a human-source shortcut even in AI-labeled text.
